abilities.description: Drawing on esoteric energies, and conducting green "spirit ichor", you may cloak your form in the veil of the void. When you are veiled and make a move to ambush, hide, or sneak, you may preset your action die to 4. In darkness, make it 5. On a miss, in addition to any other cost, you are revealed and can't veil yourself again until the current situation is resolved.

When you bathe yourself in green spirit ichor to @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.a2d7793b23c17489]{Secure an Advantage}, roll +shadow. On a hit, add +1 to any shadow rolls throughout the scene.

When your momentum is at its max, you may step into deep shadow and teleport yourself great distances. Pay one of the costs: Teleport up to several miles: @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.ff32c523829d6481]{Endure Stress} (-1); across a planet: @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.ff32c523829d6481]{Endure Stress} (-2); across a star system: @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.ff32c523829d6481]{Endure Stress} (-3); to another part of the galaxy: @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.ff32c523829d6481]{Endure Stress} (-4).
